	webhooks, err := s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, creatorID)
	// ...
	for _, hook := range webhooks {

### Request signing

**3. Mechanism:** [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com/)-style **HMAC-SHA256** in `Post` (`/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go`).

| Piece | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Key derivation | `resolveSigningKey`: `whsec_<base64>` secrets are base64-decoded; plain secrets used as raw bytes |
| Signed string | `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + JSON body` |
| MAC | `hmac.New(sha256.New, key)` |
| Headers | `webhook-id` (`msg_<uuid>`), `webhook-timestamp` (Unix seconds), `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64-mac>`) |

	if requestPayload.SigningSecret != "" {

		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
